tests.name: compare_ordered_json_duplicate_keys
tests.intent: Verify comparison of ordered_json objects with duplicate keys using the optimized single working vector allocation.

tests.name: compare_json_view_equality
tests.intent: Verify comparison between json_view objects using lockstep walking and short-circuit evaluation.

tests.name: compare_view_against_basic_json
tests.intent: Verify equality comparison between a basic_json_view and a traditional basic_json instance.

tests.name: load_image_plain_float_token
tests.intent: Verify loading JSON documents containing plain float tokens via basic_json_document::load.

tests.name: editable_document_view_behavior
tests.intent: Verify accessing and evaluating is_editable and basic_json_view methods on an editable document.

tests.name: bytes_equal_short_texts
tests.intent: Verify internal bytes_equal helper logic through key and short string lookups of various lengths.

tests.name: keys_differ_early_optimization
tests.intent: Verify early key divergence checks for objects with different initial keys.

tests.name: number_type_cross_comparison
tests.intent: Verify numeric value comparison across different number types (integer vs float) in views.

tests.name: sort_by_key_insertion_sort
tests.intent: Verify object member sorting logic with small key sets (insertion sort threshold <= 16).

tests.name: check_float_ranges_unsorted
tests.intent: Verify range checks and sorting behavior on float ranges when loading images.

tests.name: editable_document_set_and_compare
tests.intent: Verify modifications via editable document methods and subsequent view comparisons.

tests.name: lockstep_scalar_values_only
tests.intent: Verify lockstep walking optimization when objects contain only scalar values.

tests.name: array_size_precheck_inequality
tests.intent: Verify that array size pre-checks immediately reject unequal sized arrays without deep traversal.

tests.name: digit_run_scan_number_token
tests.intent: Verify fast digit_run parsing in scan_number_token for integer and float values.

tests.name: resolve_indices_unique_vs_duplicate
tests.intent: Verify member index resolution with unique and duplicate keys in standard view comparisons.

tests.name: nested_objects_geometric_growth
tests.intent: Verify comparison of deeply nested objects where geometric growth prevents reallocation.

tests.name: bytes_less_lexicographical_order
tests.intent: Verify bytes_less comparison helper by sorting and comparing keys across multiple lengths.

tests.name: check_distinct_ranges_sorted
tests.intent: Verify distinct ranges pre-check and sorting optimization during full document image load.

tests.name: json_view_type_mismatch_rejection
tests.intent: Verify fast rejection when comparing views of completely different JSON types (e.g., array vs object).

tests.name: large_member_count_stable_sort
tests.intent: Verify object member sorting fallback to stable_sort when member count exceeds the insertion sort limit (16).

tests.name: test_bytes_equal_and_less
tests.intent: Exercises bytes_equal, bytes_less, and key_less across various lengths including 4, 8, and other boundaries.

tests.name: test_object_member_resolution_and_sorting
tests.intent: Exercises sort_by_key, resolve_indices, resolve_members, same_keys, and reserve_more with small and large object member sets.

tests.name: test_view_side_and_json_side_methods
tests.intent: Exercises view_side and json_side scalar accessors (boolean, integer, unsigned_integer, floating, float_token, enter, take, first_keys, members).

tests.name: test_lockstep_and_certainly_equal
tests.intent: Exercises lockstep, certainly_equal, resume_array, floats_equal, and keys_differ_early for complex nested structures.

tests.name: test_image_float_checks_and_digit_runs
tests.intent: Exercises digit_run, all_digits, plain_float_token, scan_number_token, check_distinct_ranges, and check_float_ranges during document loading.

tests.name: test_view_side_and_json_side_methods_fixed
tests.intent: Exercises view_side and json_side scalar accessors (boolean, integer, unsigned_integer, floating, float_token, enter, take, first_keys, members).
